question: Which hormone is released in our minds when we receive a positive reaction to our posts on social media?
solution:
The correct answer is Dopamine.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the above passage it is mentioned that 'When you get a like, a share, or a positive reaction to a post, your brain releases dopamine, the same ‘reward’ chemical that you get after winning at a slot machine, eating chocolate, or smoking a cigarette,for example'.
 
• In the above lines, 'dopamine' has also been referred to as a 'reward chemical'.
 
• Hence, we can conclude that 'dopamine' is released in our minds when we receive a positive reaction to our posts on social media.
 
• Thus, option 2 is the correct answer.

​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's learn about other hormones mentioned in the option-

 
 
• ​Adrenaline- Triggers the body's fight-or-flight response. 
 
• Calcitonin- Plays a role in regulating the level of calcium in your blood by decreasing it. 
 
• Melatonin- Helps with the timing of your circadian rhythms (24-hour internal clock) and with sleep.
